name: The Fair Company's Writ-Roll
description: The Company's roll of every writ of protection it has sold on the south shore, one line a customer, in a clerk's fair hand: who paid, what, and what was done to those who stopped. The Bleaching Green's line is near the end, with the Circle's white entered against it by the bolt.

name: The Word-Seller's Primer
description: A Sayer's first primer of Hush, the Spire's own printing, with its owner's name razored off the flyleaf and every word in it priced in the margin in a clerk's hand. The last page is torn out.

name: A Shard of the Holm's Light-Stone
description: A flake of the Builders' light-stone the Brood-Mother laid round, as long as a hand, grey in daylight and faintly warm in the dark, like a hearthstone an hour after the fire. The Lamp at Gullhithe burns on the same stone.

name: The Singing Slate
description: A roofing slate split off the Cadbrae face where it meets the black course, wrapped in sacking. Held in the hand it hums, very low, a note you feel in the teeth before you hear it, and it has been humming since the autumn.

name: Writ of Protection, the Bleaching Green
description: The Fair Company's writ, nailed to the bleachers' hut door, with a bleacher's chalk under it.

name: A Writ, Torn Across
description: A Company writ torn across and pinned back together with a thorn, dropped by Pennyfold's gate.

name: The Slades' Thousand-Book
description: A quarry-book in a slate cover from the splitting-bench: three generations of Slades counting slate by the thousand.

name: Letters to the Row, Unsent
description: A bundle of a clerk's sealed letters, tied with ledger-tape, none of them sent.

name: A Receipt for Brass
description: A Tallymen's receipt-form filled in for a brass pin, pushed into the Charter Stone's crack.

name: The Masons' Lintel, Copied Fair
description: A fair copy of the masons' names on the Folly's lintel, with the Quiet Hands' closed-hand mark in the corner.

name: Bowl-Signals, for the Undercroft Run
description: A smuggler's crib on oiled cloth, folded small, from under a stone at North Cliff Beacon.

name: A Smoker's Note on the Third Arch
description: A note pinned to the aqueduct's pier with a fish-hook by a Merrowhithe smoker.

name: Chalked on the Hinge-less Door
description: The egg-collectors' chalk on the pier-house door's black jamb, copied onto a scrap by the last of them and left on the step.
